stages.purpose: Low-cost analytical triage: choose strongest existing H0b cable/contact/FE formulation, test applicability, predeclare observable signatures and validation split.
entry_conditions: No held-out validation data inspected for fitting
exit_conditions: Formulation crosswalk and H0b model specification signed
Named missing-equation retrieval trigger either documented or closed
stages.failure_route: If published formulation already includes proposed coupling, remove that H1 rationale; if equations unavailable, bounded targeted retrieval; if no applicable baseline, document applicability failure before model extension.

stages.purpose: Cheap sealed-prototype feasibility gate for coexistence, local sensing, thermal/rate controls and specimen integrity.
entry_conditions: W02 feasibility bounds and actual apparatus limits available
Pilot specimens/data clearly segregated from held-out validation
exit_conditions: Repeatable p-kappa-T coexistence map with local slip and transformation evidence
Temperature/rate/history confounds bounded or explicit thermomechanical requirement
stages.failure_route: No coexistence: stop/narrow current mechanics core. No local discriminating channels: redesign or restrict to predictive validity. Excess thermal confounding: add thermal H0b or narrow rate/domain.

stages.purpose: Quantify mechanism observability and choose minimum local/auxiliary channels before full experiments.
entry_conditions: Feasible coexistence and sealed channels shown
exit_conditions: Sensitivity/observability matrix separates slip, transformation, thermal, ovalization, membrane and fixture effects above pilot noise
Minimum observable set and controls accepted
stages.failure_route: Redesign channels, vary excitation or narrow to non-mechanistic prediction; no H1 mechanism test if rank/noise fails.

stages.purpose: Independently calibrate NiTi, friction, pressure transfer, membrane, geometry/prestrain and contact parameters; quantify nonuniqueness.
entry_conditions: Calibration tests and future held-out paths registered separately
exit_conditions: Parameter provenance, intervals/covariance and pressure-transfer uncertainty established from non-validation tests
Sensitivity shows verdict robust to remaining compensation
stages.failure_route: If pressure/contact mapping or compensation reverses predicted verdict, improve calibration or narrow domain; never fit to held-out bending.

stages.purpose: Implement and verify strongest H0b; choose thermal branch, declare metrics/tolerances, then freeze code and parameters.
entry_conditions: Observable set and calibrated parameter ranges available
exit_conditions: Transformation-aware NiTi plus wire contact plus membrane BC and appropriate cable/FE kinematics implemented
Physical parameters, code, outputs, uncertainty propagation, validation paths and tolerances timestamped and locked
stages.failure_route: Implementation/nonconvergence: repair and reverify before lock. Unidentifiable parameters: return S04. Missing thermal physics: extend H0b before held-out evaluation.

stages.purpose: Acquire controlled held-out bending and local-observable data under the locked protocol.
exit_conditions: Pressure-curvature-temperature cycles and global/local channels captured with uncertainty and QC
Fixture, membrane and cycle-history controls present
stages.failure_route: Quality/control failure: mark data non-identifying, repair apparatus and acquire a new held-out set; no validation refit.

stages.purpose: Compare locked forward H0b predictions against held-out global and local data and classify A/B/C without H1 adjudication.
entry_conditions: Complete locked model/version and validation dataset
Predeclared metrics/tolerances and uncertainty budget available
exit_conditions: Outcome A: H0b adequate; or B: systematic locked failure with independently observed local mechanism correlation; or C: uncertainty/non-identification
Residual analysis and versioned decision recorded
stages.failure_route: A: stop H1 necessity claim. B: open later H1 formulation and independent retest, without claiming H1 proved. C: redesign/narrow; if any refit is proposed, declare model version failed and require new untouched validation set.
